name: GBP Content Batches
body:
> Plan · 2026-07-17

# Summary
Four Word docs holding batched Google Business Profile post copy prepared by TAG Marketing on July 16 and 17 2026: a "Monthly Content Batch" (v1 and v2) and an "August 2026 Content Batch" (v1 and v2). Each batch gives four weekly posts per client. Nothing publishes automatically. Prestige's profile is not connected to the posting platform, so its posts are always paste-ready copy for manual posting.

# Versions
| File | Date | Scope | Status in doc |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GBP-Monthly-Content-Batch.docx` | Jul 16 | 12 drafts, 3 connected profiles (Alphalete, Summit, Pipeliners) | Drafts in GBP platform with images |
| `GBP-Monthly-Content-Batch-v2.docx` | Jul 16 | 16 posts, adds Prestige (manual copy) | Same 12 drafts plus Prestige copy |
| `GBP-Content-Batch-August-2026.docx` | Jul 17 | 16 posts, August themes from each 12-month calendar | 12 saved as GBP drafts (post IDs 8571154 to 8571165), Prestige manual |
| `GBP-Content-Batch-August-2026-v2.docx` | Jul 17 | Same 16 posts | Reworded as "nothing drafted in GBP yet", copy for review |

The Session Handoff of 2026-10-01 notes the August v2 batch had 16 posts not yet posted.

# Per client
- **Alphalete Trenchless (Colorado Springs, CO):** Monthly batch: trenchless sewer line replacement, hydro jetting, sewer camera inspection, CIPP lining (regenerated after a first pass came out as generic plumbing; longer, trim before posting). August theme "Hydro Jetting vs. Snaking": jetting vs snaking, how jetting works, signs you need jetting, preventing recurring summer clogs. Copy cites up to 4,000 PSI.
- **Summit Plumbing Pros (Mesa, AZ):** Monthly: water heater repair, faucet installation, sump pump repair, water heater installation. August theme "Why Your Drain Smells or Backs Up in Summer": summer drain odors (trap evaporation), professional drain cleaning, backup warning signs, preventing monsoon backups.
- **Pipeliners (Mesa, AZ):** Monthly: plumbing leak repair, outdoor plumbing repair, descaling, free quote offer (mentions 24-hour emergency service). August theme "Why Sewer Backups Can Get Worse During Arizona Monsoon Season": monsoon backups, root intrusion after rain, cracked pipe signs, CIPP lining (mentions a 20-year warranty).
- **Prestige Plumbing (Bluffton, SC):** owner-operated, tagline "Quality work. Honest service. Every time." Monthly: drain cleaning with 30-day clog-free guarantee, water heater and tankless install, leak detection and water line repair, whole-house filtration. August theme "Signs You Have a Hidden Water Leak": signs, bill spikes, professional leak detection, water damage risk. Claims (flat-rate pricing, free estimates, same-day service, clog-free guarantee) are stated as taken from prestigeplumbingsc.com.

# Open items (from the docs)
- Approve wording, then schedule the 12 connected drafts one per week.
- Connect Prestige's GBP to the platform to automate it; until then post manually.
- Pipeliners has 2 leftover January drafts in Pending Review: publish, reschedule or clear.

Vault note (not from the docs): before reusing the Pipeliners copy, re-check the "24-hour" and "20-year warranty" wording against the live site, since later standing rules forbid unconfirmed 24/7 and warranty claims.
